INSERT INTO code_reviews (
  request_id,
  code_language,
  code_length,
  repo_url,
  pr_number,
  combined_score,
  quality_score,
  security_score,
  recommendation,
  total_issues,
  critical_issues,
  high_issues,
  medium_issues,
  low_issues,
  top_issues,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.request_id }}',
  '{{ $json.code_info.language }}',
  {{ $json.code_info.length }},
  '{{ $json.code_info.repo_url || "" }}',
  {{ $json.code_info.pr_number || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.combined_score }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.quality_score || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.security_score || 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.review_summary.recommendation }}',
  {{ $json.review_summary.issues_count }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.issues_by_severity.critical }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.issues_by_severity.high }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.issues_by_severity.medium }},
  {{ $json.review_summary.issues_by_severity.low }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.top_issues) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
